verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no interactive API reference (a try-it console) and no runnable API examples. The only related item is a downloadable OpenAPI spec for the Events API, which is a developer building block: users could load it into their own tools, but mParticle does not provide the interactive experience itself. The 'interactive demo' mentioned in the docs covers the UI, not the API, so it is an adjacent feature and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples

citations.quote: Use the Open API (previously known as Swagger) specification or similar tools to generate helper SDKs (using Swagger Codegen or OpenAPI Generator) for the Events API
